verdict.rationale: Paxos is stablecoin and crypto infrastructure, so agent wallet custody is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence shows no programmatic wallet issuance for agents, no per-agent policy controls, and no documented limits on what an agent can move. The only related item is generic API credentials with allowed scopes (paxos-docs-2), which is a developer building block for endpoint access, not an agent-wallet safety capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, agents can hold and use wallets safely — programmatic wallet issuance for agents with scoped keys, policy controls, and documented limits on what an agent can move
